Why Vidhyah

Belief isn't the hard part.
Consistency is.

Most people who want a daily sadhana don't lack faith — they lack a practice built to survive a busy week. Vidhyah exists for that specific gap.

Without Vidhyah

Meditation apps have no mantra or Gita. Jaap counters have no meditation or reflection. The practice gets stitched across three apps, or it quietly stops.

With Vidhyah

Jaap, Dhyaan, Paath and Manan live in one place, built specifically for this practice, not adapted from a generic wellness app.

One practice, four paths

Chant, sit, read and reflect : without switching apps.

Vidhyah is built around four simple anchors: repetition, stillness, study and reflection. Pick what fits your day; the app keeps count so you don't have to.

JAAP

Mantra Chanting

Choose a mantra, set your mala target and count each repetition. Hear supported pronunciation guides, chant along with audio loops or record malas completed with your own beads.

DHYAAN

Dhyaan Meditation

Find stillness through guided meditation, immersive soundscapes or a simple timer. Choose a short sitting or stay open-ended.

PAATH

Sacred Reading

Read a daily Gita verse with its meaning, explore counsel for what you’re feeling or make time for the Hanuman Chalisa.

MANAN

Daily Reflection

Pause with a contemplation prompt, name how you feel and write a few words. Receive wisdom and a suggested practice to carry into your day.

01 / CHANT

Let your attention rest on the mantra

Choose a familiar mantra or add your own. Set your daily target and beads per mala, then let Vidhyah keep count as you chant.

For supported mantras, listen to a pronunciation guide or use a repeating audio loop that counts each completed chant.

  • ✦ Personalise your mantra, mala target and bead count.
  • ✦ Record chanting completed with a physical mala.
  • ✦ Dedicate today’s practice to someone or something meaningful.

Your beads, your pace, your intention.

02 / FIND STILLNESS

Find a way into stillness

Begin with a guided session, settle into a soundscape or sit with a simple timer. Explore Vidhyah’s collection of guided meditations and soundscapes, alongside 5, 10 and 15-minute sittings and an open-ended option.

Explore practices for morning awakening, calming an anxious mind and winding down in the evening, with soundscapes inspired by tanpura, temple rain, flowing rivers and more.

  • ✦ Explore guided sessions and soundscapes, with a selection available free.
  • ✦ Keep track of your sittings and time spent in meditation.
  • ✦ Add meditation completed away from the app.

A few quiet minutes can be your beginning.

03 / SACRED READING

Wisdom for everyday life

Read a daily Gita verse with Sanskrit, transliteration and a practical takeaway. Open the deeper explanation, explore the full Hanuman Chalisa or turn to Consult Gita for curated verses connected to feelings such as uncertainty, grief, gratitude or restlessness.

  • ✦ Daily Gita verses with meaning and commentary.
  • ✦ Hanuman Chalisa text, recitation goals and progress.
  • ✦ Consult Gita for counsel across fourteen emotional situations.

Let one verse stay with you throughout the day.

04 / DAILY REFLECTION

A moment to understand your day

Begin with a daily contemplation prompt. Choose up to two moods and write a short reflection, then receive a Gita-based insight and a suggested next practice informed by how you feel and what you’ve already completed.

  • ✦ Thirty rotating prompts across five spiritual themes.
  • ✦ Mood-aware wisdom and practical next steps.
  • ✦ A personal journal you can search, revisit and edit.

Carry one thought from the screen into the rest of your day.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

A few things you may be wondering

Is Vidhyah free?

The core daily practices are free, including mantra counting, timed meditation, Daily Gita, Hanuman Chalisa and reflection. A selection of guided meditations and soundscapes is also free. Additional guided sessions, soundscapes, Consult Gita and long-term Sankalpas are Pro features. Check the app for current availability and launch access.

Do I need to complete all four practices every day?

No. Choose what fits your time and intention. You can begin with one practice and explore the others as you wish.

Can I use my own mala?

Yes. Chant with your own beads and add the completed malas to your daily record. You can also adjust the bead count used in the app.

Can I record practice completed elsewhere?

Yes. Add physical-mala chanting, meditation time and Hanuman Chalisa recitations completed away from the app.

What happens if I miss a day?

Your practice history remains. Your Return to Sadhana journey pauses until you practise again. Streaks follow separate rules, with limited monthly freeze protection for eligible missed days.

Does Vidhyah work offline?

Core practice recording can work offline once the app is loaded. Cloud synchronization, notifications and some audio experiences need an internet connection. Offline availability varies by platform and previously loaded content.

Can I choose my reminders?

Yes. Set a time and toggle for Jaap, Dhyaan, Paath and Manan in Settings. Vidhyah also includes streak and return-to-practice notifications, subject to notification permission and eligibility.
